meta.name: game-prototype
meta.description: Invoke when the user wants to rapidly prototype a mechanic, test a proof of concept, run hypothesis-driven development, or validate a game idea before full production. Triggers on: "prototype", "proof of concept", "test this mechanic", "validate idea", "rapid prototype", "bake-off". Do NOT invoke for starting a full project (use game-start) or brainstorming concepts (use game-brainstorm). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速验证游戏机制和创意可行性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在正式开发前快速测试游戏想法
copy.tagline_en: Rapidly validate game mechanics and ideas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly test game ideas before full production

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你快速制作游戏机制的原型，帮你验证想法是否值得继续开发。它会要求你定义假设、缩小范围、快速构建，然后通过观察真实玩家来决定是继续还是放弃。
howto.when: 当你说出“原型”、“概念验证”、“测试这个机制”等关键词，或者想快速验证一个游戏想法时触发。

say.text: 我想测试一个抓钩带惯性移动的机制。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义假设并开始原型制作。

say.text: 帮我快速验证这个双人合作不对称角色的想法。
say.note: Claude 会帮你缩小范围并构建最小可测试版本。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude guides you to rapidly prototype a game mechanic, helping you define a hypothesis, scope ruthlessly, build a minimal test, and observe real players to make a kill-or-promote decision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "prototype", "proof of concept", "test this mechanic", or similar phrases indicating you want to validate a game idea quickly.

say_en.text: I want to test a grappling hook with momentum preservation.
say_en.note: Claude will help you define the hypothesis and start prototyping.

say_en.text: Help me quickly validate this asymmetric co-op role idea.
say_en.note: Claude will help you scope down and build a minimal testable version.
